rules.title: Prohibition on price fixing using algorithmic pricing
rules.requirement: Landlords renting any residential dwelling unit in Hoboken may not use software, algorithms, or data-sharing platforms to collect and analyze nonpublic competitor information in order to coordinate, recommend, or implement rental prices, lease terms, or occupancy levels among competing lessors. Violations may be brought by the Division of Housing or an aggrieved private citizen in Hoboken Municipal Court.
rules.coverage_text: All landlords renting any residential dwelling unit (any primary residence, excluding medical/long-term care or detention facilities) in the City of Hoboken.
rules.exemptions_text: Excludes medical/long-term care or detention facilities from the definition of residential dwelling unit.

exemption_tests.description: Medical/long-term care or detention facilities are not residential dwelling units.

rules.key_value: Nonpublic competitor information: less than 365 days old and not widely and readily available to the public at no cost
rules.penalty: Upon conviction, one or more of: penalties under N.J.S.A. 40:49-5; fine not exceeding $2,000; community service not exceeding 90 days.
rules.quoted_span: Landlords who rent any residential dwelling unit (defined as any primary residence excluding medical/long-term care or detention facilities) in the City of Hoboken are prohibited from price fixing using algorithmic pricing.
rules.ambiguity_note: Effective date and section number are not stated in the text.
